nl: 用 antd 风格做设备巡检：查询有设备名称；表格展示设备名称、设备编号、巡检结果、现场照片、异常描述；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「异常描述」在巡检结果为正常，或已上传现场照片时隐藏。
nlEn: Device-inspection management with an Ant Design look: query by device name; the table shows device name, device code, inspection result, site photo and fault description; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "fault description" is hidden when the inspection result is normal, or a site photo has already been uploaded.
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（跨字段 or）—— 结果正常或已传照片时隐藏异常描述（antdv/SFC）
